product_metadata.title: Ello Beacon Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler with Slider Lid and Optional Straw
features: Drinks Cold or Hot: 24 oz Vacuum insulated stainless steel tumbler perfect for an on-the-go coffee, smoothies, water, or anything in between. This stainless steel tumbler is designed to keep drinks hotter and colder for longer.
Take on Whatever the Day Brings: Equipt with a splash-resistant press-fit lid that lets you see inside and includes an optional straw.
Easy Cleaning: To ensure product quality and longevity, hand wash the tumbler. Lid is dishwasher safe.
Clean, Safe, Green: All parts are BPA free.
description: The Ello Beacon Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Tumbler keeps drinks cold up to 12 hours and hot for up to 6 hours. Perfect for smoothies, juices, water, tea, coffee and all other hydration needs, the Ello Beacon is the perfect addition to your kitchen. The lid features a splash-resistant slider for on-the-go use and includes an optional straw. An ultra-durable powder coat paint finish stands up to multiple washes and prolonged use.
